prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1032; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane of a multi-lane roadway in Conroe, Texas, when Driver 1 signaled and moved left to change lanes. Driver 2, operating a vehicle in the left lane, was alongside and the two vehicles made contact, with Driver 2's vehicle striking the left side of Driver 1's vehicle along the rear quarter panel and door. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision. Driver 1 stated that the impact jolted their body forward and then back against the seat, and reported lower back pain at the scene. Damage to Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with a sideswipe of this type, with scraping and dented panels on the left side and no other damage observed. Driver 2 confirmed the sequence of events as described by Driver 1. Two independent witnesses at the scene gave statements consistent with the account, and photographs taken at the scene match the damage pattern. Officers confirmed the presence of Driver 1 and the Passenger in the vehicle upon arrival. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the vehicle's policy. No prior damage to the vehicle was reported or observed by the responding officers.
